title: Task Cascade: Convert Diagnostic Playbooks into Idempotent Microtasks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: We maintain a large corpus of diagnostic playbooks used by SREs and first-line support. Many are long-running, manual checklists that are brittle in practice. This ticket scopes a pipeline to decompose those playbooks into small, idempotent microtasks (tasklets) that can be run interactively or composed into automated remediation flows. Goals: improve repeatability, capture provenance/telemetry at each step, enable dry-run simulation, and reduce mean time to resolution for common incidents.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Core conversion pipeline can ingest a Confluence playbook and emit a sequence of typed tasklets with metadata
A2: Generated tasklets include idempotency metadata and a recommended roll-back or safe-noop behavior
A3: Tasklets run locally in ops-sandbox in dry-run mode with no side effects
A4: Telemetry emitted for each tasklet includes duration, outcome, operator, and linked incident ID
A5: README and quickstart demo added to ops-tooling repo; PR reviewed and merged
steps: Survey top-20 high-frequency playbooks and tag common step patterns
Design canonical tasklet schema (inputs, outputs, idempotency token, compensation)
Prototype parser for Markdown/Confluence-style playbooks to extract steps
Implement tasklet runner harness with dry-run and safe-execute flags
Integrate lightweight provenance headers for audit and console UI linking
Create migration script to publish converted tasklets to ops-catalog
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff — reviewed sample playbooks with SREs (Elena Park, Jonah Li). Action: gather 20 playbooks and annotate decision points.
2026-03-04: Spike complete — parser prototype extracts 85% of step actions from Markdown exports. Edge cases: conditional branches and embedded shell fragments need heuristics.
2026-03-06: Design review — PM (Ravi Singh) prefers explicit compensation steps over automatic rollback. Decided to include both: recommended and optional auto-compensation with opt-in flag.
2026-03-08: Engineering sync — agreed schema v0.1 (see links). Miguel to implement runner; Aisha will draft telemetry spec.
2026-03-10: PR opened for tasklet schema and runner skeleton: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-tooling/pull/428. Initial feedback from reviewer (SRE team) requested clearer failure semantics.
2026-03-11: Added dry-run smoke tests in CI and a demo notebook that walks through converting a DB failover playbook. Notebook: https://drive.google.com/example-notebook
2026-03-12: Risk note — some playbooks include provider credentials in steps. We will redact secrets via the secrets-linter prior to ingestion. Follow-up: add pre-ingest scrubber (ENG-314571).
